Over the last decade, 85% of new medicines entered the American market. Meanwhile, countries like Canada fell further behind by admitting less than half of new medicines available. Canadians were then forced to seek treatment in the U.S.

The Biden admin.’s current price control scheme puts the U.S. in lockstep with countries like Canada, and it will ultimately risk patients’ access to innovative and cutting-edge medicines.
Starting now: As a member of @HouseCommerce's Health Subcommittee, I’m looking forward to discussing legislative proposals that will strengthen Medicaid access and improve program integrity.

This morning, the Biden admin.’s head of Medicaid, who oversees $500 billion of your taxpayer dollars per year, was unable or simply unwilling to answer my specific, basic questions concerning improper payments made by Medicaid last year totaling $50 billion and mandatory staffing ratios for nursing homes that most rural areas cannot meet.

Watch👇
Great news! Congrats to my friend, @CongressmanGT, on completing cancer treatment!

Starting now: @HouseCommerce's Health Subcommittee is holding a hearing to discuss the current state of CMS Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Innovation. 

Tune in ↓ https://t.co/NociI6nSxw

The U.S. continues to lead in health care; however, we continue to face a crisis of high costs, quality of care, and how we reimburse our health system. 

The Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Innovation was created as a solution to address these problems. But according to recent CBO reports, CMMI's initiatives have increased by $5.4 billion in direct federal spending from 2011 to 2020. 

This is contrary to initial projections of generating nearly $3 billion in savings. 

During today's @housecommerce Health Subcommittee hearing, I questioned our witness on CMMI's payment models and whether they are improving patient outcomes and reducing costs.

Today marks 2 years since the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline became available to all Americans. 

Since its inception, 988 has provided 24/7, confidential assistance to over 10 million Americans experiencing a mental health crisis. I'm proud to be part of this incredible, bipartisan effort to expand mental health crisis support. 

Learn more from @NAMICommunicate: https://t.co/EAlXpOZSrK

From @politico: Biden admin to spend billions to blunt spike in Medicare drug premiums

When the Biden-Harris administration pushed for the so-called ‘Inflation Reduction Act’, we sounded the alarm this would happen. We’re over $35 trillion in debt; we must be extremely mindful of how we spend taxpayer dollars. It’s clear that’s not a priority for the Biden-Harris administration.

https://t.co/fwdwRRFO2F

My statement on the Biden-Harris administration’s plan to artificially set prescription drug prices:

When it comes to health care, we need patient-focused solutions, lower prices, and more cures; however, under the Biden-Harris administration’s so-called ‘Inflation Reduction Act’ – which imposes an artificial drug pricing scheme – patients will experience the exact opposite.

I agree that we should be finding solutions to help drive down the cost of health care in this country, but it should not come at the expense of American medicinal research and innovation. 

The @HouseCommerce Committee will continue pushing back on this administration’s misguided policies, and we will work toward solutions that put patients and their needs first without impeding their access to critical drugs and cures.

Starting now: as a member of @HouseCommerce's Health Subcommittee, I'll be participating in a hearing to evaluate the FDA's human foods and tobacco programs.

Tune in ↓
https://t.co/a7sdXTyBWT

I enjoyed meeting with the Information Technology and Innovation Foundation this morning to discuss my priorities as a member of the @HouseCommerce Committee. Our discussion was wide ranging and focused on numerous policies, including health care, energy, and telecom. 

As I discussed with the attendees, I’ve been able to work as Chair of the Communications & Technology Subcommittee to increase broadband Internet access, secure our communications networks from cyberattacks, and lead the world in spectrum management. Thank you for having me!
